motifs.summary: Move an agent through a grid, maze or corridor to reach a target square.
features: A large traversable region of uniform value, divided by walls of a different value
A small compound object that reads as the agent (a cross, a diamond)
Four actions available, consistent with up/down/left/right
A reference pattern or target position held in a separate region
probes: Try ACTION1-4 once each and confirm which direction each one moves
Move into a wall and see whether it blocks, reflects, or passes through
action_semantics: ACTION5/6, when present, are a special interaction: grab, drop, submit
motifs.win_condition: The agent reaches the target square, or reproduces a reference pattern

motifs.summary: Push blocks (never pull) onto goal positions.
features: Two or more blocks drawn as a border with contents inside
Movable blocks that are distinct from the agent or cursor
A wide movement area with corridors formed by walls
A reference image showing where the blocks are supposed to end up
probes: Walk the agent into a block and see whether contact pushes it
Push a block into a wall and watch what the collision does
action_semantics: ACTION1-4: move the agent; contact with a block pushes it
motifs.win_condition: Every block sits exactly on its target position

motifs.summary: Extend a trail or assemble parts, in order, into a target shape.
features: A diamond or arrow-shaped agent with a horizontal tail extending from it
A vertical rail the agent moves along to change its height
A reference image of the finished shape, with blocks already threaded on the tail
Several independent blocks anchored against one wall
probes: ACTION1/2 for vertical movement along the rail
ACTION3/4 to extend and retract the tail
Extend the tail toward a block and watch the interaction
action_semantics: ACTION1=UP and ACTION2=DOWN along the rail
motifs.win_condition: Every block is threaded onto the tail in the order the reference shows

motifs.summary: Move a cursor or brush and change cell values to reproduce a reference pattern.
features: A large single-valued canvas region
A small cursor or brush object sitting on the canvas
A separate reference pattern, usually above or below the canvas
An action that paints rather than moves
probes: Move the cursor with ACTION3/4 and confirm it is the cursor moving, not the canvas
Paint once at the current position
Move away after painting and check the change persisted
motifs.win_condition: The canvas matches the reference pattern exactly

motifs.summary: Flip cells or blocks between two values, or around a cycle, to reach a target pattern.
features: A grid alternating between two values
Often only one or two actions available
A cursor that moves over the grid, toggling on move or on a dedicated action
probes: Toggle once and see which cell changed -- one, a row, a cross, a region
Toggle the same cell twice: returning to the original state means binary, a third state means a cycle
action_semantics: ACTION1-4: move the cursor, where movement exists
motifs.win_condition: Every cell matches the target state -- a checkerboard, one colour, or a reference pattern

motifs.summary: Infer the rule behind a sequence of colours or values and fill the gap.
features: Colour blocks arranged as sequences along the edges of the frame
Often only one action available, so the game is read-then-submit
A reference region listing the available values
Markers at the frame corners
probes: Analyse the pattern completely before acting -- reading costs no actions and this is where that matters most
Then one action, to learn whether it submits or cycles a value
action_semantics: ACTION6: submit, or cycle a colour
motifs.win_condition: The sequence rule holds on every edge

motifs.summary: Assign the right colour to each of N slots; a reference image shows the order.
features: N empty slots in a row
A palette of available colours, usually above
A reference showing the correct order, usually below
About three actions, and notably no directional movement
probes: Cycle a slot's colour and record the cycle order
Find the action that moves between slots
Find the action that submits
action_semantics: ACTION5: move to the next slot
motifs.win_condition: Every slot's colour matches the reference order

motifs.summary: Rearrange blocks or tiles into a target order or position -- sliding, pick-and-place, swap.
features: Many patterned blocks laid out as a grid
A separate reference pattern showing the target order
An agent that reads as an empty container the same size as one block
Four-direction movement
probes: Move the agent and check the step size -- one cell, or one block
Move onto a block and see whether it picks up, swaps, or pushes
action_semantics: Landing on a block may pick it up or swap automatically
motifs.win_condition: The blocks are arranged in the reference order

motifs.summary: Complete a mirror or rotational symmetry, or make two regions match.
features: The board splits cleanly left/right or top/bottom into two halves of different value
The two halves are similar but not identical
A wall may sit on the dividing axis
Markers placed symmetrically on both sides
probes: Move once and check whether one side changed or both did
Look for an action that flips or mirrors rather than moves
action_semantics: ACTION1-4: move, or edit a boundary
motifs.win_condition: The two regions are exact mirrors across the dividing axis

motifs.summary: Move a crosshair or cursor and select a marker at a specific coordinate.
features: A large cross spanning the whole board
A cursor marker at the intersection
Small markers scattered around the grid
Five actions: four directions plus a click
probes: Move once and check whether the whole cross moves or only the intersection
Click both on and off a marker, and compare
motifs.win_condition: Every target marker has been clicked, possibly in a required order

motifs.summary: An object is launched, travels, and bounces off walls toward a target.
features: A diagonal trail extending from the agent
Often a single action, so the only choice is when to press it
Large blob-shaped obstacles
A target position, often at the far edge
probes: One action: does the agent move, or does its direction change
Several in a row: read the trajectory and find the reflection rule
action_semantics: ACTION6: advance one step, change direction, or launch
motifs.win_condition: The agent arrives exactly on the target

motifs.summary: Blocks fall; move or rotate them to stack or assemble at the bottom.
features: L-shaped or T-shaped pieces
A floor region at the bottom
A small piece hanging or floating near the top
Around six actions: left, right, two rotations, and one or two drops
probes: ACTION1/2 for horizontal movement
ACTION3/4 for rotation -- watch the piece's shape change, not its position
Test a drop last: a hard drop is usually irreversible, so it is the expensive probe
motifs.win_condition: Pieces are placed with no gaps, or some stated arrangement is reached

motifs.summary: Objects slide along a diagonal, or two actions pick between binary directions.
features: Diagonal markers forming a 45-degree path
A ring-shaped object with a hollow centre
Only two actions available
A start point (the object) and an end point (the target marker)
probes: One of each action, and compare direction and distance
Alternate them to see how flexible the path is
action_semantics: One action per diagonal direction -- e.g. down-left and down-right
motifs.win_condition: The object arrives at the target along the diagonal path

motifs.summary: Meeting a condition opens a wall or activates a new route.
Find a route through impassable walls and passable corridors.
features: Walls and corridors alternating inside a large rectangular structure
A reference region showing the agent's shape
A visible track marking the traversable route
Five actions: four directions plus one special
probes: Move in each direction and confirm the mapping
Walk into a wall and observe the response
action_semantics: ACTION5: grab / drop, or another special interaction
motifs.win_condition: The agent reaches the maze exit

motifs.summary: Mirror an object or pattern across an axis to place it symmetrically.
Combine or divide blocks to make a new shape.
The agent leaves a trail behind it as it moves; the trail's shape is what solves the level.
Move around the map gathering scattered items or markers.
features: A mostly empty background with a few scattered objects
A frame structure at the centre that displays what has been collected
An agent standing apart from the objects
Five actions: four directions plus collect or deliver
probes: Move the agent toward an object
On contact, try the fifth action and see whether it picks up or delivers
motifs.win_condition: Every item has been collected and delivered to the centre

motifs.summary: The order of actions *is* the answer; the level clears on the correct sequence.
Circular-shift rows or columns, or rotate a block in 90-degree steps, to line things up.
features: A 3x3 block grid
A cursor and a target marker at opposite diagonal corners
Four actions, plausibly row and column rotations
Often no reference pattern -- the goal is a rule, not a picture
probes: One action, then ask whether the cursor moved or a whole row/column shifted
Read the changed cells to find the axis and the direction
action_semantics: ACTION1/2: rotate a row left/right, or move up/down
ACTION3/4: rotate a column up/down, or move left/right
motifs.win_condition: The grid reaches a checkerboard or some other stated arrangement

motifs.summary: Fit a shaped block exactly into a gap; size and shape matching is the point.
features: A large object with a hole in it
A separate block exactly the size of that hole
The size match between hole and block is visually obvious
probes: Find which directions the block can move
Move it toward the hole and learn the insertion mechanic
action_semantics: Often only two movement directions are available
motifs.win_condition: The block sits exactly inside the hole
